title: wahlenbergia rubioides var. stokoei
intro:

The plant is believed to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis and allergies. The bioactive constituents of Wahlenbergia rubioides var. stokoei include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
